item.title: Sharjeel Imam and the sob story session at Delhi Press Club: Debunking tall claims made by the ‘secular-liberal’ gang
item.description: A careful examination of the data, court decisions, and background information points to a story more in line with legal accountability than pure unfairness, despite their collective narrative portraying Imam as a victim of a vengeful system.

item.title: Madras HC strikes down order of DMK govt that allowed commercial use of surplus funds of historic Kallazhagar temple: Read what the court said
item.description: The court made it clear that temples cannot be treated like development projects and that any activity carried out in the name of 'development' must strictly align with the religious ethos of the institution and the law governing temple administration.

item.title: Gold and Silver record their worst fall in decades: What triggered the historic crash? Explained
item.description: A hawkish Fed signal, a rebounding dollar and aggressive profit booking by big investors punctured the gold–silver euphoria, turning an overbought rally into a historic, panic-driven crash.

item.title: Delhi: 6-year-old girl raped by three minor Muslim boys in Bhajanpura, main accused flees to Bihar as family pleads for justice. OpIndia Ground Report
item.description: A six-year-old girl was brutally assaulted by three minor boys in Delhi's Bhajanpura. While two suspects are detained, the family alleges a 10-hour police delay allowed the main accused to flee to Bihar. The community is now demanding immediate justice and accountability.

item.title: Sunetra Pawar sworn in as Maharashtra’s first woman Deputy CM, move seen as bid to protect Ajit Pawar’s legacy amid NCP power tussle
item.description: Sharad Pawar hinted at a rushed decision. He said, "Ajit's plane crash put the merger talks on hold."

item.title: A story of Hindu resilience and revival: How a unique Kumbh Mela, which was stopped following Islamic invasions, was brought to life in Bengal after 700 years
item.description: Tribeni Kumbh Mela is not a modern invention or political project as claimed by propaganda outlets. It is a sacred landscape, sustained by geography, scripture, practice and collective memory. Its Sangam, its snas, and its melas firmly lie within the continuum of Hindu civilisational tradition.

item.title: As PM Modi visits Dera Sachkhand Ballan on Sant Ravidas Jayanti, know who Ravidassiyas are, and why they consider themselves separate from mainstream Sikhism
item.description: The Prime Minister’s Punjab visit includes renaming Adampur airport after Guru Ravidas. His visit comes amid heightened political focus on Dalit outreach, with Dera Ballan wielding influence across Doaba ahead of the state’s assembly elections.

item.title: Modi government presents a growth-oriented budget prioritising infrastructure, welfare, and industry with focus on fiscal discipline: An analysis of key numbers
item.description: India’s Union Budget 2026 has laid out an ambitious but fiscally cautious roadmap, with the government placing big numbers on the table for spending, taxation, borrowing and deficit reduction

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: ‘Convert to Islam or face criminal cases’, Hindu man from Kanpur accuses wife of assault and threats; read FIR details
item.description: The FIR accessed by OpIndia states that the accused, a Muslim woman, assaulted the complainant who is a Hindu man, threatened legal harassment, and left the matrimonial home with cash and jewellery.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Allocation for the Healthcare sector gets a hike of 10% as the central government aims to enhance access and affordability
item.description: One of the healthcare highlights of the budget is the decision to establish a national institute for mental healthcare in Ranchi, Jharkhand.
